messages.content: Reprice the Norfolk trip as a two-night stay with the Wednesday flight. The return moved later, correct?

Correct. The Wednesday nonstop ORF-ORD now leaves at 7:22 p.m., 40 minutes later than the 6:42 p.m. option, and arrives at 8:46 p.m. The Monday outbound is unchanged: ORD-CLT-ORF from 5:05 to 10:18 p.m. The round trip is now $468.
And the downtown hotel is Monday and Tuesday nights only? I do not want a Wednesday night accidentally attached.

Yes. Courtyard Norfolk Downtown is set for check-in Monday and checkout Wednesday: one room, two nights. The cancellable rate is $169 per night, $386.92 with taxes. Parking is $20 per night, so the expected hotel total is $426.92 if you park both nights.
Good. What happened to the car rate?

The Avis midsize at $184.16 expired. The available replacement is an Avis compact for $217.64 total, picked up at ORF Monday after your 10:18 p.m. arrival and returned Wednesday evening. It is pay at pickup, includes unlimited mileage, and can be canceled without charge before pickup.
The counter will still be open Monday, and I can return it after hours Wednesday? Verify both parts.

Verified. The ORF Avis counter is scheduled to remain open until 11:30 p.m. Monday. Your pickup is entered for 10:40 p.m. Wednesday's return can be completed after the counter closes: park in an Avis return space in the rental garage, record the fuel level and mileage, and place the locked car's key and completed rental jacket in the Avis drop box beside the return counter. Avis closes the contract when staff inspect the car the next morning, so keep timestamped photos of the exterior, dashboard, fuel gauge, and parking location.
Now give me the full price and make sure Wednesday still works from Virginia Beach.

The priced total is $1,112.56: $468 airfare, $426.92 hotel including two nights of parking, and $217.64 for the car. That excludes fuel, meals, tolls, and roughly $8-$12 for Tuesday parking near the Virginia Beach visit. On Wednesday, leave the Virginia Beach restaurant by 4:25 p.m. Take I-264 west to I-64 west, refuel near Military Highway, and continue to ORF. Normal driving plus fuel should put you at the rental return around 5:35 p.m., 1 hour 47 minutes before departure.
Is that enough time with the key drop rather than handing it to someone?

Yes. After parking and documenting the car, allow about 15 minutes for the key drop and walk to the terminal. You should reach the terminal around 5:50 p.m., leaving about 92 minutes before the 7:22 p.m. departure. The later flight lets the Virginia Beach visit run without compressing it, though I would still leave at 4:25 because weekday traffic on I-264 can build quickly.
All right. Book the flight, the two hotel nights, and that replacement car. Do not add prepaid fuel or extra coverage.

Before purchase, the final terms are: the $468 economy ticket is nonrefundable but can be changed for airline credit subject to any fare difference; the Courtyard rate can be canceled without penalty through 11:59 p.m. local time Sunday, after which one night's room and tax applies; and the Avis compact is pay later with no prepaid fuel or optional coverage selected. The combined expected total remains $1,112.56 before the excluded trip costs.

Booked. Flight confirmation N6R3PV covers Monday ORD-CLT-ORF, 5:05-10:18 p.m., and Wednesday ORF-ORD nonstop, 7:22-8:46 p.m., for $468. Courtyard Norfolk Downtown confirmation CY-842619 is for Monday check-in through Wednesday checkout, two nights at $386.92 with taxes; parking is charged at $20 nightly. Avis confirmation AV-395742 is for a compact at ORF, Monday 10:40 p.m. through Wednesday 5:35 p.m., totaling $217.64, with after-hours return by the garage drop box. Wednesday, leave Virginia Beach at 4:25 p.m. for an expected 5:35 p.m. car return and 5:50 p.m. terminal arrival. Keep the flight, hotel, and car confirmations together with the return photos.
